svg.title: iOS · Interval grading viewer · Crop · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoAdjustmentsPanel.swift's Crop group (`cropContent`, `aspectChips`, `select(_:)`, `cropHint`, the shared App/RotationSlider.swift in its .stacked shape) and App/EditorControls/CropFrameOverlay.swift on the picture, inside App/PhotoViewerView.swift's `phoneEditorBody` (`openPanel(for:)`, `cropBinding`, `phoneFoot`). New 2026-09-13 for the editor controls redesign (board 2a with Crop open, spec §10 and decision 3). Crop replaces the old Rotation section: aspect chips + the frame on the picture + the Angle slider. THE MODEL: `PhotoAdjustments.crop: FrameCrop?` — a normalized rect in the LEVELLED frame's unit square plus an aspect (original · 1:1 · 4:5 · 16:9 · 9:16 · custom) — static, carried whole by the timeline like the mixer (held from the earlier keyframe, never blended), kept OUT of presets and OUT of the Original/Edited verdict like rotation, encoded only when set; Original is no crop at all, Custom keeps the rectangle and frees its ratio, a ratio fits the largest centred frame of that shape into the levelled picture. In the editor the picture is never resized by the crop: the frame is drawn OVER the full picture and every other coordinate space (zoom, 1:1, text layers, masks) stays put. LAYOUT (2a / 6a, `phoneEditorBody`): the picture fills the safe area (59 top / 34 bottom on this canvas) and is fitted into it — a 3:4 portrait shoot spans the width and centres vertically, 176…700 — and everything else floats over it. `touchChrome`: the 36 pt back disc at (16, 71) and the `EditorTabPill` top-right (right 16, top 74: 12 pt of vertical padding under the safe area, the 30 pt pill centred on the 36 pt disc) — the boards draw both at top 60, the app sits them 11 pt lower. The pill is rgba(28,28,30,.85) over material, radius 18, 12 pt semibold, the selected tab amber with black text, the rest amber on ink; Frames appears only on a shoot with more than one frame. The foot (`phoneFoot`) is bottom-anchored on the safe area: the timeline card where `hasTimeline`, then EITHER the six main buttons (`EditorGroupBar(.phone)`) OR the open group's sheet (`PhotoAdjustmentsPanel(layout: .phone)`) — one or the other, the sheet needs the buttons' room. The sheet: 22 pt top corners, rgba(28,28,30,.86) over material running under the home indicator, padded 12 top / 16 sides / 0 bottom, 10 pt between rows, shadow up; header = title 15 pt semibold white · 6 pt dot (accent when the group holds a value or a travelling field, clear otherwise so the row never reflows) · spacer · ✕ 32 pt white 10 % (reverts to the snapshot `openPanel(for:)` took) · ✓ 32 pt amber (keeps and closes). Long-press the title for Reset <group> / Reset all adjustments. The 1:1 toggle (`zoomControls`, 32 pt black 45 %) sits bottom-trailing of the picture pane 12 pt in, lifted above the foot by its measured height; it exists only while `hasPixelsToReveal`, so a small source shows none. The readouts print the app's own formats (`%+.2f`, `%+.0f`, unsigned 0…100, Kelvin) with a real minus sign, U+2212, like the boards (`PhotoAdjustmentsPanel.minusSigned`, 2026-09-13). THIS CANVAS: 16:9 locked, so the scrim shows (the hook stages Original, where the frame is the whole picture and nothing is dimmed; there is no aspect argument). The frame (`CropFrameOverlay`, panel open): black 55 % outside it, a 1 pt white 90 % edge, rule-of-thirds hairlines at white 35 %, and four 3 pt white L-brackets (18 pt arms, 36 pt hit areas) exactly on the corners; drag the body to move, drag a corner to resize against the opposite corner (locked ratios stay locked), two-finger pinch to scale. Closed with a crop set, the picture shows an 85 % scrim with a 1 pt frame and no handles. The sheet: six equal 56 pt aspect chips 5 pt apart (28 pt, radius 12, 11.5 pt semibold; the selected one amber with black text, the rest white 8 %), the hint in 11 pt white 50 % ('Locked to 16:9 · drag to move, pinch or drag a corner to scale' / 'Free crop · drag corners, drag to move, pinch to scale' / 'Original · the whole picture' — the app's own copy for Original, where the board's 'Locked to Original · drag to move…' described a frame that cannot move), then the Angle row (`RotationSlider(.stacked)`: 13.5 pt secondary label, 12.5 pt semibold readout, the native slider) and its 11 pt tertiary caption. THE PICTURE'S FIT (fixed 2026-09-13): while the Crop panel is open `phoneEditorBody` fits the picture into the room BELOW the chrome row and ABOVE the foot instead of centring it behind both — a tall picture's bottom handles would otherwise lie under the sheet's material, where the sheet takes the touch, and its top handles under the back disc and the tab pill, which take it first. The pane is padded `touchChromeHeight` 60 + `phoneCropMargin` 24 at the top, 24 at the sides and the foot's measured height + 24 at the bottom, so a corner handle's 36 pt reach (18 pt past the corner) clears every control: on this canvas the room is 24…369 × 143…471 (safe top 59 + 84 down to the card's head 495 − 24), and a 3:4 picture fits it height-bound at 246×328, centred at x 73.5. The 1:1 toggle needs no lift of its own while cropping — the pane already ends above the foot — so it sits 12 pt inside the pane's bottom-trailing corner. Board 2a keeps the picture full height; on this phone that would bury the bottom handles under a 214 pt sheet, so the re-fit stands (stage-G capture iphone-crop.png showed the old safe-area-top start; iphone-crop-v2.png the fit drawn here). Staged by LL_EDITOR=latest LL_VIEWER=1 LL_KEYFRAMES=sunset LL_SECTIONS=crop.
